note: The published colour-vision simulations the composed fixtures apply to a screenshot, each a 3 x 3 matrix on LINEAR sRGB. protanopia, deuteranopia and tritanopia: Machado, Oliveira and Fernandes, 'A Physiologically-based Model for Simulation of Color Vision Deficiency', IEEE TVCG 15(6), 2009, severity 1.0; protanomaly, deuteranomaly and tritanomaly are the same paper's matrices at severity 0.5 (the weak-cone case the colour-contrast screen of #48 section 4 also runs). grayscale: the relative-luminance weights of ITU-R BT.709 / WCAG 2.x (0.2126, 0.7152, 0.0722) applied to linear sRGB and written back to all three channels. Nothing here is computed by the page.
